integrity: All stated identities and limits are analytic; the supplementary checker uses finite cutoffs and does not certify the improper integral. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed integer dimensions d >= 3 are covered; the strong-type endpoint itself is not a bounded operator case.
The positive constant is defined by a convergent improper Bessel difference; no elementary closed form is established.
Strict endpoint difference positivity rests on the finite-cell theorem in arXiv:2610.19648, rather than an independent proof of that theorem.
Historical priority is not independently certified; numerical quadrature is supplementary.
title: Critical fractional-power collapse of the sharp spherical mixed-norm stability gap
